preflight.native_converter_help:
usage: /Users/hans-wernereberhardt/PycharmProjects/llama-server/experiments/slipstream_20261017/runtime/Slipstream.app/Contents/Resources/resources/pgrn-convert --input model.gguf --output model.pgrn [--expect-sha256 HEX]
          [--min-free-gb N=16] [--io-threads N] [--progress jsonl]
          [--dry-run] [--no-verify] [--resume] [--no-journal]

  --resume      continue an interrupted conversion from its .partial +
                .partial.journal, re-checking the CRC of everything
                already written before appending
  --no-journal  do not keep a resume journal; a cancelled run then
                deletes its .partial as before

exit codes: 0 done, 1 error, 2 cancelled (resumable)
